links.outcome: Readability of chatbot palliative care answers versus recommended 6th grade level
links.effect: Answers of all 5 chatbots were at an educational level well above the 6th grade level; differences significant in all formulas (P < .001). Readability easiest to hardest: Bard, Copilot, Perplexity, ChatGPT, Gemini.
links.quote: The answers of all 5 artificial intelligence robots were determined to be at an educational level well above the 6th grade level.

links.outcome: Reading level of chatbot patient education content versus recommended 6th grade level
links.effect: All 5 chatbots' median readability indexes were significantly above the 6th grade level in all formulas (P < .001).
links.quote: According to the results of our study answers of all 5 AI chatbots were compared with the 6th grade reading level, statistically significant differences were observed in the all formulas (P < .001).

screen.reason: Evaluates readability, reliability, and quality of responses from multiple commercial LLMs on palliative care questions, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
